datasheet_identity.title: MMSZ4678 THRU MMSZ4717 Surface Mount Zener Diodes

extraction_notes: The MMSZ4699 row gives VZ min 11.40 V, nominal 12 V, max 12.60 V at IZT=50 uA, and IR=0.05 uA at VR=9.1 V.
No diode electrical characteristic curve for the MMSZ4699 variant is published; the page 3 plots are thermal only.
The public PDF identifies the manufacturer as Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology Co., Ltd.; the frozen catalog identity is hongjiacheng.
extraction.omission_reason: No usable electrical diode curve is published for MMSZ4699; only power-derating and transient-thermal plots are present.
